description: This file defines API routes for managing restaurant menus and menu items in a food delivery platform using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting menus and menu items, along with permission checks for owner or admin roles.

methods.name: None _assert_owner_or_admin_for_restaurant(session: AsyncSession, user: AuthUser, restaurant_id: UUID)
methods.description: Checks if the user is the owner or an admin for a given restaurant.

methods.name: List[MenuOut] list_menus_for_restaurant(restaurant_id: UUID, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Lists all menus for a specified restaurant (public).

methods.name: MenuWithItemsOut get_menu_with_items(menu_id: UUID, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific menu along with its items (public).

methods.name: MenuOut create_menu( payload: MenuCreate, user: AuthUser = Depends(require_roles("restaurant", "admin")), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Creates a new menu for a restaurant, requiring owner or admin role.

methods.name: dict delete_menu( menu_id: UUID, user: AuthUser = Depends(require_roles("restaurant", "admin")), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Deletes a specified menu, owner/admin only.

methods.name: MenuItemOut create_menu_item( payload: MenuItemCreate, user: AuthUser = Depends(require_roles("restaurant", "admin")), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Creates a new menu item associated with a menu, owner/admin only.

methods.name: MenuItemOut update_menu_item( item_id: UUID, payload: MenuItemUpdate, user: AuthUser = Depends(require_roles("restaurant", "admin")), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Updates an existing menu item, owner/admin only.

methods.name: dict delete_menu_item( item_id: UUID, user: AuthUser = Depends(require_roles("restaurant", "admin")), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Deletes a specific menu item, owner/admin only.
